1. "id": the result of (14 times 3) plus 79 — as a number, not a string
2. "name": the word "harbor" spelled BACKWARDS, all lowercase
3. "tags": exactly these 5 strings sorted in REVERSE alphabetical (Z to A) order: "brick", "flint", "ember", "delta", "humus"
4. "active": the boolean true (not a string)
5. "meta": a nested object with exactly two keys — "len": the number of letters in "harbor" (as a number), and "even": a boolean saying whether the value of "id" is an even number
Any extra key, wrong type, wrong order inside "tags", wrong nesting, or wrong casing counts as a mistake.
